author: ColorTraining
title: No monitors have been detected.
summary: Power Display reports an empty monitor list on an HP Fury laptop/dock setup even though Windows Display settings shows the internal panel and three Eizo monitors. The author also asks about ICC color management; the existing triage request for a concrete repro has not been answered.

issue_context.summary: Power Display returns no monitors for a reported HP Fury/dock setup even though Windows lists its displays; the report additionally asks about ICC profiles.
known_information: PowerToys version is v0.102.2814.0 and the reported install source is auto-update.
The reporter identifies an HP Fury 16 with an i9-12950HX, an HP dock, two Eizo 3895 monitors, one Eizo T2381W, and the laptop display.
The reporter says all displays appear in Windows System > Display but Power Display reports none.
No bug-report ZIP is attached; the only comment asks the author for concrete reproduction steps.
The report separately asks whether Power Display supports ICC color management.
inferences: The failure may occur while enumerating active Windows display paths or while routing those paths through WMI/DDC-CI discovery; the issue evidence does not identify which stage fails.
The inspected Power Display discovery/control path does not establish ICC-profile support or prove that no such feature exists elsewhere.
issue_context.analysis: Current Power Display code turns the active DisplayConfig inventory into monitor candidates, then tries WMI and DDC/CI discovery; a fresh report after the empty state can distinguish an empty inventory from a controller failure. The existing author request is still outstanding, so asking again now would duplicate it.
initial_investigation: Checked upstream source at microsoft/PowerToys main commit 1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a.
src/modules/powerdisplay/PowerDisplay.Lib/Drivers/DisplayConfigInventory.cs queries active display paths and skips entries when source GDI name or target device path is unavailable.

src/modules/powerdisplay/PowerDisplay.Lib/Services/MonitorManager.cs routes the inventory through WMI and DDC/CI, returns an empty list when inventory is empty, and logs controller discovery failures.
src/modules/powerdisplay/PowerDisplay/ViewModels/MainViewModel.Monitors.cs applies the discovery result to the UI monitor list.
No linked upstream PR or matching fork trace was found; no ICC implementation claim was made from this focused discovery-path review.

information_gaps.information: The exact launch/dock/sleep/reconnect sequence that produces the empty Power Display list, and whether it happens on every launch with the dock already connected.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates a repeatable startup failure from a display-topology transition and narrows the discovery stage to investigate.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with short numbered steps, including whether the dock was connected before Power Display opened and whether sleep, wake, undocking, or reconnecting changes the result.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP captured while Power Display is showing no monitors.
information_gaps.why_needed: The discovery logs can show whether active DisplayConfig paths were enumerated and whether WMI/DDC-CI controller discovery failed.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce the empty state, then add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward.
